Then reason: list the bonds between non-hydrogen atoms one by one: 1 upper Me–O bond, 1 upper O–central C bond, 1 lower Me–O bond, 1 lower O–central C bond, 1 central C–N bond, 1 N–Me/lower-right carbon bond. planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In line-angle/condensed organic notation, every explicit line between two non-hydrogen atoms is a bond; a condensed label such as MeO contains a C–O bond; arrows and electron dots are not bonds; bonds involving H are excluded.
